_doc: Curated corpus <-> Cost Index edge list. HUMAN-AUTHORED, ASSERTION-FREE: an entry says 'this article I wrote leans on this tracked ingredient' — a curatorial statement about our own prose, never a claim about the world. Nothing here can be false in the way the fact gate cares about, which is why it is safe under a pattern-blocklist gate that cannot do semantics. Keys are '<namespace>/<slug>' where namespace is 'library' or 'blog', so the library/blog ambiguity is resolved in the key, not by probing. Ingredient keys must exist in data/cost-index-sources.json#ingredients AND have a rendered cost-index/<key>/index.html page. NEVER seed this file by matching ingredient names against article prose: naive matching flagged 55/55 articles (apple/Apple, lemon/lime/date/turkey/sage/ginger are homographs). Every edge is added by a human who read the paragraph. Gated by scripts/check-article-cost-index-map.mjs (fail-CI).

library/what-beef-prices-mean-for-your-r.note: Article names all four cuts explicitly (ribeye x7, tenderloin x4, short rib x4, ground beef x5) and its thesis is that 'beef' is not a price — the per-cut reads are the point.

library/keep-plate-cost-honest-when-pric.note: Romaine is the worked spike example (x7) and the 75%-yield trim case; tomato is the second worked line. Both illustrative in prose — the block is what keeps a reader from acting on the illustration.

library/restaurant-prime-cost.note: Green beans is the one named tracked ingredient in an otherwise deliberately illustrative arithmetic walkthrough. NOTE: this slug is absent from data/library-tags.json#blog_posts — that is a separate pre-existing gap, deliberately not fixed here (19 scripts read that file).

library/restaurant-menu-engineering.note: Yield/cost anchors are explicitly directional; chicken is the named case. Single edge on purpose — the article is method, not market.

blog/restaurant-menu-inflation-2026.note: Dated dispatch. It cites muntin_cost_index_ribeye_2026_06 at $11.59 @ 2026-06-05 by name; the block sits BELOW that as the current read so the of-record figure stays untouched.
